description: This file contains JavaScript code customizing navigation behavior for a Drupal theme, including functions for toggling navigation, initializing event handlers, and managing accessibility features.

methods.name: isNavOpen
methods.description: Checks if the navigation wrapper element contains the 'is-active' class, indicating if the navigation is open.

methods.name: toggleNav
methods.description: Opens or closes the header navigation by toggling relevant classes and ARIA attributes based on the provided state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes navigation event handlers, accessibility features, and responsive behaviors for the header navigation.
